'''2020 TMW Pods Stephen Squirlock LS They Have No Idea We're Coming''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Squirlock]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
